UNTIL 4 AM HST TUESDAY FOR THE FOLLOWING AREAS

A TORNADO WATCH MEANS CONDITIONS ARE FAVORABLE FOR TORNADOES IN

THE LOOKOUT FOR THREATENING WEATHER CONDITIONS AND LISTEN FOR
LATER STATEMENTS AND POSSIBLE WARNINGS.
